semantics.purchase_intervals: Each preserved template column B:EO receives internal ordinal interval 0:143; interval 0 is [00:00,00:10). Template labels are 10 minutes late and remain unchanged.
semantics.mapping: Column-mapping CSV and date-mapping CSV form an exact Cartesian mapping: Excel cell = excel_column + excel_row, for each listed sheet and date.
semantics.planned_daily_quantity: Sum of the 144 midnight planned_grid values q0, excluding emergency electricity.
semantics.planned_daily_cost: Sum of original_fee only. This is the original ordinary contract fee, not total cost including emergency electricity.
semantics.adjusted_daily_quantity: Sum of the 144 final contract_grid values; these are final ordinary contract quantities, not net adjustments.
semantics.adjusted_daily_cost: Sum of original_fee + increase_fee + decrease_penalty - refund across every interval, including all adjustment events. This ordinary contract total already includes original_fee and must not be added again to planned-sheet cost.
semantics.total_cost: Ordinary contract net fee + emergency_fee. Emergency cost and overall cost remain explicit in internal daily CSV and this independent export ledger; no extra template sheet or header added.
semantics.battery: Six 4-hour blocks per day. Charge/discharge are separate AC-bus kWh totals; state cells are battery-internal kWh at 00:00 and 24:00. Daily states are continuous, not reset.
semantics.emergency: Merge emergency intervals >1e-7 kWh only when adjacent within the same date, matching the source solver-audit tolerance. Do not merge across a zero/below-tolerance interval or midnight. Omitted positive floating-point tails are quantified in the independent ledger. A day with no active emergency has one row with interval 无 and numeric 0; it is not an emergency event.
semantics.template_expansion: Replace sample ellipsis blocks by all 334 days, preserving header text and repeated prototype styles. Battery has 334*6 data rows; emergency rows vary by actual event count.
